parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: 路由优先级。整数类型，数字越小，优先级越高

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: 路由状态。0表示在线，1表示下线，2表示创建或更新错误

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh update-istio-route-additional-status --service-mesh-id c08ba3fd1e6484b0f8cc1ad8fe10d0000 --istio-gateway-name ingressgateway --route-name http-test --priority 0 --status 0 --description demo_route --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh UpdateIstioRouteAdditionalStatus --region cn-hangzhou --Status 0 --Description demo_route --ServiceMeshId c08ba3fd1e6484b0f8cc1ad8fe10d0000 --Priority 0 --RouteName 'http-test' --IstioGatewayName ingressgateway
